name: Context window h-sweep ablation
analysis:
h-sweep确认credit assignment decay hypothesis但curve不够clean。h=5是cliff区域（从4.7%到h=10的18.8%有4x跳跃）。关键发现：intermediate h值(10,20)部分有效，说明threshold不是binary而是gradual degradation。但h=10和h=20之间的gap(11pp)小于h=20和full之间的gap(6pp)，暗示diminishing returns。Reviewer可能argue h=20已经'good enough'——需要在paper中强调full context的额外6pp在deployment中的cumulative价值。

Median档下h-sweep大体展示预期趋势但存在噪声。h=2完全崩溃（gamma^(50-2)≈0），h=5勉强有信号但仅4.7%（cliff位于h=5-10之间，符合median指标h_cliff=3-8）。h=10到h=20的跳跃(18.8→29.7)不完全单调——某些seed下h=10偶尔超过h=20的个别eval batch，造成noise。h=full达到35.9%但未突破40%阈值。整体趋势清晰但不像理想情况那样perfectly monotonic，存在reviewer可以质疑的边界case。

name: Multi-seed replication (3 seeds)
analysis:
Std=4.7pp在可接受范围但不够tight。Seed2的29.7%是potential weakness——reviewer可能argue这接近step-independent上界。Defense：即使worst seed(29.7%)仍远超step-independent(0-6%)，gap仍然dramatic(24-30pp)。但无法claim '≥40% convergence'——需要更多seeds或更长training来tighten confidence interval。Paper措辞需调整为'converges to 30-39% range'而非固定数字。

Median档下multi-seed std在5-8pp范围。三个seed分别为35.9/29.7/39.1%，std≈4.7pp——略低于median范围下限(5pp)但接近。Seed2表现较差(29.7%)拉低mean至34.9%，刚好落在median指标[30,42]内。Variance主要来自early training的exploration randomness——不同seed在step 3-5的trajectory divergence决定了最终收敛点。action_is_valid更稳定(std 2.9pp)因为它是easier sub-task。

name: Credit assignment mechanism analysis
description: 可视化effective discount、gradient signal strength、episode length correlation
analysis:
Mechanism analysis清晰支撑narrative：credit assignment decay是exponential的，gradient signal在small h下是noise-dominated。Key insight for paper：不仅是signal弱，而且variance高——small-h模型实际在做random walk而非learning。Episode length correlation提供additional evidence但不是smoking gun(r=-0.43)。整体sufficient for methodology paper的Figure 2，但需要careful framing避免over-claim因果关系。

Mechanism analysis主要是对h-sweep数据的post-hoc分析。Gradient signal strength与effective discount高度相关(r>0.95)——这是数学必然。Episode length与performance负相关(r=-0.43, p=0.008)说明longer episodes在small-h下受害更严重——这支撑mechanism story。但correlation是moderate(-0.43)而非strong，因为episode success还受task difficulty影响。Gradient variance在h=2时极高(0.89)说明信号几乎是noise。

name: Action-change statistics from always-on runs
analysis:
Confirmatory rate 68.8%确认核心motivation——大多数verification是浪费。但r=0.19的correlation偏弱，需要careful framing。不能claim 'action-change strongly predicts success'，只能说'action-change is a meaningful but noisy signal for verification informativeness'。Per-task breakdown显示examine类task最高(38.1%)——可能因为这类task需要更多exploration/correction。Paper应强调这是'proof-of-concept evidence'而非conclusive。

Median档下confirmatory rate在55-75%范围——这里68.8%。意味着接近70%的verification没有改变agent行为，支撑'most verification is wasted'的narrative。但action-change与success的correlation仅r=0.19(在median的0.15-0.25范围内)——这是moderate信号，sufficient for motivation但不够强到支撑action-change作为standalone reward的strong claim。Late steps的action-change率更高(41.3%)因为agent在episode后期更likely偏离正轨，需要correction。

name: Selective verification implementation
description: Code implementation of binary verify/skip mechanism (no GPU needed)
analysis:
Implementation milestone，无experimental findings。关键设计决策：(1) verify/skip作为special token在每步action前输出，(2) reward中action_change仅在verify时计算(skip时为0)，(3) verification_cost是constant penalty per verify。这些design choices在plan_012的ablation中会被验证。

纯code实现，无实验数据。实现binary verify/skip decision token，reward = task_success + alpha * action_change_when_verified - beta * verification_cost。Alpha=0.5和beta=0.1是initial hyperparameters，后续plan_007中调优。

name: B-IAVR selective verification training
description: 从best episode-level checkpoint初始化，训练selective verification policy
analysis:
B-IAVR学到了一些selectivity但效果不够dramatic。Policy趋向于在early steps skip(因为early steps action-change率低)但在late steps几乎always verify。验证率从100%降到71.2%——仅~29%reduction。Success loss 4.6pp在可接受范围但combined with modest cost saving使得overall story偏弱。Paper中需要frame为'proof-of-concept that selective verification is learnable via RL'而非'a system that dramatically reduces cost'。

Median档下selective verification效果有限：verification rate仅降低28.8%(未达40%目标)，且success delta为-4.6pp(在median的3-8pp范围内但偏大)。这是因为：(1) base model仅35.9% success，headroom本就有限——从weak model上训练selectivity更难，因为model本身就不确定何时verification有帮助；(2) action-change signal仅r=0.19的correlation，reward信号noisy导致policy学到的是conservative strategy(倾向verify)而非optimal selective；(3) 28.8%的verification reduction虽然存在但cost-performance tradeoff不dramatic——需要几乎always verify才能维持本就不高的success rate。

name: Selective verification full comparison
analysis:
Full comparison确认verification有价值(12.5pp gap)但selective的marginal benefit有限。B-IAVR在Pareto frontier上but仅marginally优于confidence-threshold。这意味着Claim 3无法以strong形式成立——paper需调整为：'B-IAVR demonstrates that RL can learn selectivity, but the current action-change signal provides limited advantage over simpler heuristics at this model capacity'。Framing应转向'the gap between always-on and no-verify motivates future work on better verification signals'。

Median档下B-IAVR在Pareto frontier上marginally优于baselines但差距不大。与random-50%相比：B-IAVR用更多verification(71.2% vs 50%)获得更多success(31.3% vs 28.1%)——说明B-IAVR的selectivity有signal但不dramatic。与confidence-threshold相比几乎持平(31.3% vs 30.5% success, 71.2% vs 62.4% verify)——confidence-threshold更aggressive(verify少10pp)但success仅差0.8pp，暗示学到的policy和simple heuristic差别有限。Key finding：verification本身有价值(always-on 35.9% vs no-verify 23.4%=12.5pp gap)，但SELECTIVE verification的额外价值(vs random/confidence)是marginal的。

name: No-verify ablation
analysis:
12.5pp gap是paper中supporting verification value的关键数据点。Without verification, episodes倾向于更长(42.1 vs 38.7 steps)因为agent wandering而非converging。这支撑Section 2的motivation ('verification helps but is costly → selective is needed')。即使B-IAVR最终效果modest，no-verify ablation确认了research direction的合理性。

No-verify在median档下收敛至23.4%——比always-on(35.9%)低12.5pp。这证明verification有实质价值。差距来源：without verification，agent在错误action后无法self-correct，导致episode在early mistake后cascading failure。12.5pp gap对于paper是strong evidence that verification matters——即使selective verification效果不dramatic，always-on verification的价值已被establish。action_is_valid略低(85.7% vs 90.6%)因为without verification feedback，model less aware of action validity constraints。

name: Entropy-controlled action-change analysis
description: 控制policy entropy后检验action-change-success partial correlation
analysis:
Defense成立但marginal——action-change不是pure noise(p<0.05)但信号弱。High entropy episodes有更多action-change(38.7% vs 24.3%)但更低success(30.1% vs 38.5%)——说明部分action-change确实是exploration noise而非informative correction。Paper应acknowledge this nuance:'while action-change survives entropy control, the modest partial correlation (r=0.14) suggests that stronger reward signals for verification informativeness remain an open problem'。

Median档下partial correlation从0.19降至0.14——entropy确实解释了部分action-change variance(r=0.34 between entropy and action-change)，但控制后correlation仍然significant(p=0.031)。这意味着action-change不完全是entropy/randomness的artifact，但signal偏弱(r=0.14)。各entropy stratum内的correlation基本一致(0.11-0.16)，说明relationship不依赖于specific entropy regime。对于paper够用作defense('action-change signal survives entropy control')但不够强到claim causal relationship。

name: Causal intervention: random vs verification-triggered changes
description: 注入random action changes对比verification-triggered changes的success rate
analysis:
Causal evidence存在但偏弱。7.4pp delta不够large(hypothesis was ≥10pp)且p=0.042 barely passes threshold。有趣的是no-change baseline(34.1%)高于random(31.8%)——说明random changes有时harmful。Paper应frame为'preliminary causal evidence that verification-triggered corrections are non-random, though the effect size is modest'。Combined with entropy analysis, 构成Claim 2的supporting evidence bundle，单独每个都不够strong但together形成coherent picture。

Median档下verification-triggered changes优于random但delta仅7.4pp(未达hypothesis的≥10pp)。关键insight：verification-triggered在成功率上(39.2%)高于no-change baseline(34.1%)说明verification有selective correction能力；但random changes也并非灾难性(31.8%)——有时random perturbation碰巧correct。7.4pp差距p=0.042，barely significant。这是'存在causal signal但不strong'的典型median档结果——够写进paper作为supporting evidence但不够作为standalone claim。

name: Reward signal ablation (action-change vs alternatives)
analysis:
Action-change marginally best但优势不compelling。Paper应honest acknowledge：'action-change reward achieves the best success-to-cost ratio, but the margin over confidence-based baseline is modest (1.2pp success, 2.7pp cost difference). This suggests that at current model capacity, the choice of verification reward signal is less critical than the training methodology itself—reinforcing our focus on episode-level training as the primary contribution.'这naturally转向70% methodology narrative。

Median档下action-change reward略优但差距不dramatic。Action-change(31.3% success)优于random(27.8%)3.5pp和confidence(30.1%)1.2pp。但random reward的verification rate更低(54.3%)导致更大cost reduction(31.4%)——trade-off不clear-cut。Confidence-based与action-change几乎持平，暗示在这个model capacity下两种信号效果类似。这confirm了'action-change is a reasonable reward signal'但不能claim it's dramatically better——consistent with median tier的'selective verification效果有限'。

name: ARES reproduction + comparison
description: 复现ARES SFT router，与B-IAVR head-to-head对比
analysis:
ARES对比结果要求paper做careful positioning。不能claim domination——而是frame差异：(1) B-IAVR不需要human-labeled verification relevance data(ARES SFT需要)，(2) B-IAVR自动适应action-change statistics，(3) tradeoff：RL更conservative但SFT更直接有效。Paper table should highlight methodological differences(RL vs SFT, online vs offline, binary vs continuous)而非只看numbers。Competitive positioning变为'complementary approaches'而非'we beat ARES'。

Median档下B-IAVR与ARES对比结果mixed：B-IAVR success略高(31.3 vs 29.7, +1.6pp)但cost reduction更差(22.1% vs 33.8%)。ARES的SFT router更aggressive(58.3% verify)因为supervised signal更直接；B-IAVR的RL policy更conservative。ARES reproduction未达原paper的52.7% token reduction——可能因为我们的setup(ALFWorld+1.7B model)与原paper不同。整体不能claim 'B-IAVR dominates ARES'(原hypothesis ≥10pp better cost reduction at matched success未达成)。需要frame为'different trade-off points: RL-based B-IAVR prioritizes success preservation while SFT-based ARES is more cost-aggressive'。

name: ScienceWorld transfer
description: 在ScienceWorld上验证episode-level vs step-independent优势
analysis:
Transfer成功addresses single-env concern。Episode-level advantage在ScienceWorld上reproduce(7.4x ratio)。不同env的absolute performance差异可归因于task difficulty而非method failure。Paper可argue：'episode-level training methodology generalizes across interactive environments with different action spaces and episode structures'。This strengthens Claim 1 (methodology contribution) independent of Claim 2/3's weakness。

Median档下ScienceWorld上episode-level优势依然dramatic(22.8% vs 3.1%, 7.4x)但absolute success偏低(22.8% vs ALFWorld的35.9%)。ScienceWorld harder because：(1) larger action space，(2) more complex state tracking，(3) longer episodes on average。Step-independent再次catastrophically collapse(3.1%接近random)。7.4x ratio(虽然不到ALFWorld的无穷大因为ALFWorld step-ind=0%)仍然是strong evidence for generalization。但absolute 22.8%意味着model在此env上capacity不足——不能做meaningful selective verification experiment on ScienceWorld。

name: 7B model scaling verification
analysis:
7B结果是paper的strong supplementary evidence。Episode-level advantage不仅holds而且在absolute terms更impressive at scale(48.4%)。Step-independent即使在7B上仍collapse——refutes potential reviewer argument 'just use bigger model to compensate for credit assignment issues'。This result could motivate reframing paper conclusion：'episode-level training is prerequisite at ALL scales for multi-turn RL, and its benefit grows with model capacity'。如果paper space permits，这是compelling argument for methodology contribution。

Median档下7B model在episode-level上达到48.4%——超过1.7B的35.9%约12.5pp，符合scaling expectation。Step-independent仍catastrophically低(5.3%)但不完全为0(比1.7B的0%略好——larger model有更多capacity做limited credit assignment)。Convergence更快(8 steps vs 12)因为7B model初始capability更强。Key implication：7B结果暗示method scales——如果have更多compute，更大model可能达到60%+，使selective verification story更compelling。但这在当前resource constraint下是future work。

name: Per-task-type breakdown analysis
analysis:
Per-task breakdown提供两个paper contributions：(1) demonstrates within-environment diversity(addresses single-env concern partially)，(2) strong correlation between episode length and difficulty supports credit assignment mechanism story。Reviewer defense：即使single env(ALFWorld)，task types span substantial complexity range(18-42% success, 28-45 steps)。Pick_two和examine的低success(18-23%)也暗示1.7B model capacity limit——selective verification在这些hard tasks上可能更有价值但base performance太低无法meaningful测试。

Median档下task breakdown展示within-environment diversity：shorter/simpler tasks(pick:42.1%, length 28.3)表现最好，longer/complex tasks(pick_two:18.2%, length 44.6; examine:22.7%, length 41.2)表现较差。Episode length与per-task success高度负相关(r=-0.87)——longer tasks suffer more from credit assignment(即使用full context，longer episodes仍有higher variance)。This supports mechanism story：credit assignment difficulty与episode length直接相关。Pick_two最差因为需要sequential two-object manipulation——更长trajectory且更多potential failure points。
